name: Chicken Tenders with Za'atar Yogurt & Minty Arugula-Pistachio Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place mayo and spices in a medium bowl, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
mayonnaise
¼ tsp garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice crosswise into ¾-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Add bread crumbs to the bowl with the chicken and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the za'atar yogurt and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup plain Greek yogurt
mayonnaise
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp thyme, dried
½ tsp sesame seeds
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ English cucumber
½ small pkg fresh mint
½ (5 oz) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp white wine vinegar
1 tsp honey
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl.
When the chicken is almost done, add arugula to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide chicken tenders and salad between plates. Serve with za'atar yogurt for dipping and enjoy!
